name: MTV Roadies
description: MTV Roadies is a youth-based popular reality television show. It is an Indian version of the original show, Road Rules. In this show, a group of contestants travel to different destinations and participate in various tasks that challenge their physical, social and mental strength.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: On Day 1, the Roadies are introduced to each other and whisked away to an MTV party in Chennai.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The Roadies look for their bikes and find out who rides with whom.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The Roadies have their bikes taken away from them, and hey have to hitchhike almost 300 km to their next destination, Gullapur in Karnataka.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Roadies reach Karwar, where the role reversal happens. The girls have to fish for food and the boys have to keep the house, cook, clean and wash clothes.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The Roadies ride to Goa, party hard on board a private ferry with MTV VJs, and vote off one roadie.

videos.title: SURVIVING THE AUDITIONS
videos.overview: The season begins with the Pune auditions. It's early morning and already a long queue of over 1400 show up.

videos.title: BEHOSH AT THE AUDITIONS
videos.overview: After all the tears, joys and arguments at the Pune auditions, the audition gang, move to Kolkata and Delhi.

videos.title: FRIENDS TURN FOES IN CHANDIGARH
videos.overview: We are covering the auditions in Chandigarh and Mumbai. The Chandigarh guys express their opinions very forcefully. At the GD everyone yelled at the other.

videos.title: MEET THE NEW ROADIES
videos.overview: Finally the judges have made their choice, and now 14 Roadies hopefuls have been asked to come to Mumbai. Of these, only 7 will become roadies.

videos.title: JHAGDA-JHAGDI CHALU!
videos.overview: So the journey begins. The roadies have landed in Kolkata. They are shown to their rooms, pick their riding partners and then get dressed for the launch party to be held at TANTRA.

videos.title: First day, first task
videos.overview: It's the day after the party, and its 5.15 am. Aarti has to get everyone out of bed and in the lobby in 15 minutes! The Roadies are led to the Victoria Memorial in Kolkata where the boys select their bikes and then get individual lessons from Hero Honda professionals. Post lunch the Roadies had to perform their first task on the river Hoogli.

Roadies Revolution: The Grand Premiere
videos.overview: For the first time ever - the biggest youth reality show, Roadies Revolution, premieres.

videos.title: Can Soumya survive Neha's questions?
videos.overview: Soumya Sachdeva, a flight attendant is put on the spot as gang leader Neha Dhupia cross questions her intent to bring in the revolution to the show. But with her gaining support from gang leaders Prince Narula and Nikhil Chinapa, will she get a chance to prove herself? Tune in to this episode to know what follows and more.

videos.title: Pratibha bats for self-defence!
videos.overview: Pratibha Singh, a dentist from Bhopal and also a trained jujutsu player advocates for self-defence techniques and training for women all over India in light of the current situation for women in the country. She also shows a few tricks and techniques with the help of gang leader, Prince Narula and host, Sohil Singh Jhuti. Tune in to this episode to get an insight on Pratibha's will to bring about a revolution.

videos.title: Ladies who built their own world!
videos.overview: A smile that can light up a country! This is what Apoorva Gole hears from the judges after putting her inspirational story at the table. Upon getting called to the interview with a fellow interviewee, Akanksha Singh, the competition between them turns out to be cut-throat. Watch the episode as every challenge is executed flawlessly.

videos.title: Sehej, a warrior within!
videos.overview: The world of weightlifting and powerlifting might be dominated by the males, but Sehej Maini is here to change the game, and she does it in some awe-inspiring fashion. The inspiring sportswoman swells the country with pride by winning a bronze medal in a bench press event during the World Powerlifting Championship. Watch as she spreads her inspiration and zeal in the audition and more.

videos.title: Deepika - Battling life, with a smile!
videos.overview: The battle intensifies, as Sakshi Sharma, a policewoman from Punjab walks in alongside the oh-so-talented, Deepika Shekhawat, from Jaipur. After the duo successfully showcases their talents, the judges are taken aback when Deepika reveals her constant struggle with bipolar disorder and the rough and tough hurdles in her life. Watch as the judges share their constructive feedbacks and more, in a yet another grueling audition round of Roadies.

videos.title: Brain vs Brawn!
videos.overview: The Chandigarh auditions resume with an impressive battle between two participants, Nisha Dhaundiyal and Ayushi Dogra. While Nisha outshines Ayushi in physical fitness, Ayushi impresses the judges with her spectacular mental strength. Who will win this combat between brain and brawn?

videos.title: Rannvijay unleashes Kakoli!
videos.overview: Rannvijay Singha gives an opportunity to the participant, Kakoli Mondal to unleash all her pent-up fury for the relentless child abuse that she faced in her life. What follows next is a completely new avatar of Kakoli that flabbergasts the judges!

videos.title: Got the guts, get the glory!
videos.overview: For the first time on Roadies Revolution, four contestants from different states and backgrounds audition to become a part of the revolution. Out of the four, who will secure their spot for the Culling Round?

videos.title: The Culling Round showstopper- Nisha!
videos.overview: OMG! The ruthless Culling Round just keeps getting better as it brings unequivocal amount of talent, passion and determination. However, Nisha Dhaundiyal, with her spectacular flexibility surpasses the fierce competition and steals the show! Also, watch the episode to find out who else survives the cut-throat competition and joins the Roadies Revolution journey.

videos.title: Two, six, heave!
videos.overview: Roadies Revolution marks the beginning of its journey in Rishikesh where the Roadies meet the leaders. And just when they all seem to settle, Rannvijay Singha re-introduces Roadies Revolution in its raw form and throws them the first task of the season that requires solving complex puzzles, brute strength and all of the senses! Follow their journey of loyalty and betrayal on Roadies Revolution.

videos.title: The great Roadie cook-off!
videos.overview: With Pratibha Singh being the only immune Roadie this week, tension mounts as the remaining 14 contestants are in the danger zone. Their next task involves cooking for school children and effect a change to inspire the youth. The contender who sells the maximum number of dishes gains immunity. Who is the best cook in the house?

videos.title: Neha gives Sakib an earful!
videos.overview: As the Roadies reach their first eliminations, Rannvijay Singha gives each of the leaders a chance to save two contestants from being voted out. However, he adds a twist to the mix and reveals that the members of the winning team have a chance to take away 3 of those immunities. When Sakib Khan's immunity gets snatched away, Neha Dhupia is utterly shocked by his calm demeanour and questions his passion for the journey. Will Sakib's attitude cost him dearly on the show?

videos.title: Let the task commence
videos.overview: Nikhil Chinapa and Neha Dhupia's teams have already started to get penalties, whereas the contestants under Prince Narula's leadership have won the lead. Now it is up to Nikhil and Neha to level up and push harder towards victory. And in the next task, the contestants will have to portray the perfect yoga posture when the name of the asana is revealed. Who will ace the task?

videos.title: Will Neha be Akshita's saviour?
videos.overview: As the Roadies reach another round of eliminations, Akshita Sharma is worried that she might get voted out as the other Roadies are upset with her actions. However, she receives a ray of hope when Rannvijay Singha announces that the leaders have an opportunity to save one of them. With Akshita having betrayed Neha Dhupia's trust during an earlier task and costing her a win, will she even consider helping Akshita in her desperate time of need?

videos.title: Team Nikhil nailed it!
videos.overview: As the Roadies Revolution escapade reaches the beautiful city, Rishikesh, Team Raftaar begins the EDM task with a bang, however, Nikhil Chinapa's team takes the entertainment to its peak with their hilarious dance extravaganza. Will their performance win them the immunity?

videos.title: Double Elimination, Double Drama
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose as Neha Dhupia expresses her disappointment with Pratibha Singh and the former gets even more disgruntled as she tries to justify her actions. Moreover, as Rannvijay Singha announces that there is going to be double elimination, a fiasco unfolds followed by the dirty politics of elimination. Which two contestants are going to be victims of this deadly elimination?

videos.title: Let the Hadippa Games begin!
videos.overview: Moving forward on to the next leg of their journey, the Roadies arrive at Rupnagar. What awaits them? Their next task - the Hadippa Games! Tune in to know which team marches to victory in this high-octane and gritty episode

videos.title: Goggles, pots and some balance!
videos.overview: After team Anthwasi and Hakuna Matata win one point each in the disc throw task, team Loyalty and Singh Raj decide to pull up their socks to ace the balancing act. As the other teams have already gained the upper hand, will Loyalty and Singh Raj ace up to the mark?

videos.title: Rannvijay ke chaar bomb!
videos.overview: The Roadies are left shell-shocked as they see Bhawish Madaan, Prakhar Narayan, Taniya Hussain and Poonam Shah, the four finalists from the OPPO MTV Roadies Battleground enter the show. Further, Rannvijay Singha throws yet another googly in the form of an open double vote out during which, one non-immune Roadie gets a special OPPO advantage. With the pre-existing catfights and tense competition, who will Lady Luck shine upon and which two Roadies will face the brutal elimination?

videos.title: Survival war - This is Eent!
videos.overview: The four Battleground finalists and the two recently voted-out Roadies, Apoorva Gole and Arushi Chawla, are divided into two teams to compete in the task, This is Eent! Rannvijay Singha reveals that the winning team will survive and the losing team will go home. But he gives the leaders one last chance to save one contestant at the cost of a star. Who will win the thrilling task? Will any leader agree to save someone?

videos.title: Underdogs at their best!
videos.overview: The underdogs go up against the Favourites in the next task, 'Halke Me Mat Lo.' While the Favourites struggle to effectively communicate among themselves, the underdogs manage to establish teamwork as their forte. Although, will they be able to match up to the Favourites?

videos.title: A chance to snatch immunity!
videos.overview: The Underdogs have won the immunity, but the Favourites get a chance to snatch away the same through a set of three tasks given by Rannvijay Singha himself! How will they make use of this opportunity?

videos.title: Rannvijay does it again!
videos.overview: The Roadies make a stop at Garli, a mountainous place that has acquired the status of a first heritage village in Himachal Pradesh. But the joy of exploring the streets of Garli is cut short when Rannvijay Singha slides in a surprise vote out! With no one having immunity to evade the risk of elimination, what will be the outcome at the end of the day?

videos.title: Behold the new wildcard entry!
videos.overview: The Roadies return fitter and meaner after the 6-month long COVID-19 break with a clear picture of their true friends and frenemies in the show. And as soon as they arrive, Rannvijay Singha takes the surprise element up a notch and introduces the first-ever digitally auditioned wildcard entry, Shreya Kalra! With a huge shift in the dynamics of the game, who will get voted out?

videos.title: Jayant: To perform or not to perform?
videos.overview: After a near physical altercation between Apoorva Gole and Ayushi Chawla, the Roadies move forward to another task! However, the task can't be taken lightly, as Michael Ajay challenges Jayant Yadav, putting the latter between a rock and a hard place.

videos.title: A Roadies double whammy
videos.overview: Allegations, accusations, and tears flow abound in the vote-out ground, but all the plotting goes in vain when Rannvijay Singha announces a double vote out! Tune in to find out who stays and who goes home, in this dramatic episode.

videos.title: Brawl for survival
videos.overview: As the task to gain immunity commences, the Roadies are split into two teams - Team Neha Dhupia against Team Nikhil Chinapa-Varun Sood. Even though the leaders are a bit confused while choosing the contestants, they waste no time and begin the Basket Brawl, which is a mixture of basketball, rugby and wrestling. Whose team will dominate the home stretch and win the immunity?

videos.title: Arushi demands action against Pratibha
videos.overview: Pratibha Singh's actions during the previous task make Arushi Chawla demand strong action against the former at the vote out. How will the other contestants and leaders react to Arushi's demands?

videos.title: Who will be the 'Drone Survivor'?
videos.overview: Sanjay Negi and Arushi Chawla choose teams to take on the Drone Survivor task, where one team member will have to run an obstacle course while they get shot by the opposing team with paintballs. Which team will blaze through and save their leader from elimination?

videos.title: A vote out with a twist
videos.overview: While Neha Dhupia lays out a plan to form her team, Nikhil Chinapa receives blunt feedback from Shreya Kalra about being partial in the game. Later, five unsafe Roadies get a chance to vote by performing three consecutive tasks. Who will win the task and who will walk the road to elimination?

videos.title: Prince is back, and he's angry!
videos.overview: Rannvijay Singha welcomes back Prince Narula and begins the new task called Gong Wrong, a quiz in which all the three teams enter into a battle of the brains to win the immunity. After the task, Rannvijay drops a bombshell and reveals that there is going to be double elimination. Further, Prince loses his temper when two of his team members are on the brink of elimination. Will Prince use his star and save a team member?

videos.title: Dumb charades in Roadies style!
videos.overview: Rannvijay Singha blows everyone's minds with yet another vote-out task. For the new dumb charades task, Neha Dhupia partners up with Prince Narula's team and begins the task with sheer confidence. But trouble knocks at their door when Aman Poddar fails to guess an easy movie name. Will Aman's blunder cost the task for Team Neha and Team Prince?

videos.title: Shreya's vote sends shockwaves
videos.overview: The Roadies kick it up to the final gear as Hamid Barkzi wins the ticket to the finale and becomes the first finalist. However, the big shocker comes during vote out when Shreya Kalra chooses Abhimanyu Raghav to go home with her. Is there a conspiracy at play?

videos.title: Semi-finale strikes hard!
videos.overview: The sword of the semi-finale task strikes hard on the Roadies as they come to know that there will only be three of them going forward to the finale. And, as if it was not enough, their stress level skyrockets when they see some old frenemies returning to be a part of the game. Who will see the light of the next day, and who will be walking away with heads hung low?

videos.title: Who will be the ultimate Roadie?
videos.overview: The finalists get emotional as they get to call their family and seek their blessings and love. Finally, the Grand Finale arrives as Jayanth Yadav, Hamid Barkzi, and Micheal Ajay are ready to give their everything and become the ultimate Roadie. Which team will seize the Roadies Revolution title?

videos.title: Kya Vaat, Kya Vaat, Kya Vaat!
Ilzaam Pe Ilzaam, Elvish Ke Naam
